articles.title: US dollar hovers near 19-month high, Aussie falls after soft jobs data
articles.description: The US dollar is near a 19-month high due to hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials. The Australian dollar fell to a ten-month low after disappointing employment figures were reported. The euro and sterling are under pressure while the yen hovers around the key 160 level. Bond yields dropped following a successful 20-year auction and declining oil prices eased inflation concerns.

articles.title: Oil Price Today (November 19): Brent crude rises to $93 as Trump likely weighs fresh Iran attacks. What are experts saying?
articles.description: Crude oil price : In light of escalating tensions between the U.S. and Iran, oil prices have remained surprisingly stable. President Trump is reportedly weighing potential U.S. strikes against Iran, while upcoming discussions with global leaders like Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin could significantly influence trade dynamics. Goldman Sachs has adjusted its oil forecasts upwards, anticipating supply challenges, whereas the International Energy Agency predicts a global surplus in oil supply by the year's end.
